page.title: Skills
page.intro: Playbooks your agents can follow. Switch a skill on per agent; every edit keeps the earlier revisions.

empty: No skills yet. Write one or install one below.

add.title: Add a skill
add.folder: From a folder on the server
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: Lowercase words joined by dashes, e.g. supplier-quotes
add.descriptionHint: One line, e.g. “Use when preparing a quote for a client”
add.pathHint: The full path of a folder with a SKILL.md, on the machine PasaBot runs on
add.urlHint: An https address of a repository; it is pinned to the commit it has now
add.safety: Nothing in a skill is run when it is installed. It starts switched off for every agent.
add.cardHint: Write a new skill, or install one from a folder, a git URL or a .zip.
add.descriptionMissing: Say when to use it first

detail.agentMadeNote: An agent wrote or changed this skill. Read it before switching it on for other agents.

edit.title: SKILL.md
edit.hint: Saving makes a new revision. The name in the front matter stays the same.
edit.label: Skill text

rev.title: Revisions
rev.label: Revision {{rev}}
rev.rolledBack: Rolled back: the text of revision {{rev}} is now the newest revision.

perm.workspaceOnly: Files: only its agent’s own workspace
perm.hostsHint: One per line, like example.com or *.example.com. Leave empty for none.
perm.messagingAsk: May send messages to other people (each one still asks you first)
perm.before: Permissions to record for this skill:
perm.messagingYes: Yes, and each one asks you first
perm.none: No permissions recorded for this skill.
perm.proposedIntro: An imported agent or an agent asked for these. Nothing is recorded until you approve. New items are marked.
perm.scope: Recorded only: these limits are checked when a run is bound to this skill. Ordinary chat turns are not limited by them yet.
perm.toolsHint: One per line. A tool from an outside connection is written server/tool. Leave empty for none.
perm.first: Nothing is approved for this skill yet; everything below is new.
perm.widens: This changes the permissions you approved before.
perm.changed: This request changed after you opened it. Look at the new version below before you decide.
perm.unsaved: {{name}} is installed, but its permissions were not saved ({{reason}}).
perm.hostBad: Write each website as a name only, like example.com or *.example.com (no https:// or paths, at most 253 characters).
perm.toolBad: Write each tool as its name only, without spaces (at most 200 characters).

builtin.datastore-guide: Use when you need to keep structured records (lists, logs, inventories, prices) that other agents may also read, using the shared PasaBot datastore tools.
builtin.site-publisher: Use when the owner wants a small web page or static site (a report, a menu, a shareable list) published on this PasaBot server.
builtin.skill-author: Use when the owner asks you to turn a way of working into a reusable skill, or to improve a skill you made earlier.

page.title: Your helpers' abilities
page.intro: Step-by-step guides your helpers can follow. Switch each one on per helper; every edit keeps the earlier versions.

plain.empty: Nothing here yet. Write one or add one below.

add.title: Add an ability
add.folder: From a folder on this computer
add.safety: Nothing in it runs when you add it. It starts switched off for every helper.
add.cardHint: Write one yourself, or bring one in from a file.

detail.agentMadeNote: A helper wrote or changed this. Read it before switching it on for other helpers.

perm.workspaceOnly: Files: only its helper’s own folder
perm.before: Permissions to note down for it:
perm.proposedIntro: A helper, or one brought in from a file, asked for these. Nothing is noted until you approve. New items are marked.
perm.scope: Noted only: these limits are checked when a job is tied to it. Ordinary chats are not limited by them yet.
perm.toolsHint: One per line. A tool from an outside app is written app/tool. Leave empty for none.
perm.first: Nothing is approved for it yet; everything below is new.

builtin.datastore-guide: Helps a helper keep tidy lists and records (logs, stock, prices) that other helpers can read too.
builtin.site-publisher: Helps a helper make a small web page (a report, a menu, a list to share) and put it online from this computer.
builtin.skill-author: Helps a helper turn a way of working into an ability it can reuse, or improve one it made before.
